snippet.title: Past Due: Midnight - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The workday is over.
The nightmare has just begun.

Venture through a twisted corporate office in this first-person psychological horror. An ordinary evening of overtime turns into a nightmare. You awaken at midnight, trapped in a place you no longer recognize. You are alone… or so it seems. Follow the clues, crack the riddles, and unfold the phantom story. Can you survive the night and escape alive?
